pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding of pine wood to achieve a relatively homogeneous particle size of less than 1 mm (20 mesh).
Chemical pretreatment using an 8% w/w sodium hydroxide (NaOH) solution.
Thermal treatment during the chemical process with incubation temperatures of either 0 °C or 100 °C for retention times of 10, 30, or 60 minutes.
